structure: Part 3, Main import reason. Read in full: prototype-specs/e2e/about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js (440 lines; the 'main import reason' describe at lines 236-323 and the germinal 'germinal reasons' test at 401-439 are this slice) and prototype-specs/e2e/snagging.fit.spec.js (557 lines; the 'main import reason' describe S09-S12 at lines 198-243 is this slice). Mined all 12 traces the part names, every action list in full, each opened in folder part3: (1) about-the-consignment--main-import-reason-lists-every-reason-with-its-hint, (2) ...-a-reason-is-optional-to-proceed, (3) ...-internal-market-reveals-the-purposes-and-needs-one, (4) ...-transhipment-needs-a-destination-country, (5) ...-transit-needs-a-port-of-exit-and-a-destination-country, (6) ...-temporary-admission-horses-needs-a-real-exit-date-and-a-port-of-exit, (7) ...-the-prototype-seed-route-jumps-straight-to-the-reason-page, (8) about-the-consignment--germinal-products-section-1-germinal-reasons-internal-market-and-transit-only-with-consignment-wording, (9) snagging--main-import-reason-s09-main-import-reason-heading, (10) ...-s10-main-import-reason-fields-under-each-child-radio, (11) ...-s11-main-import-reason-temporary-admission-exit-date-picker, (12) ...-s12-main-import-reason-spacing-between-the-exit-date-and-the-port-of-exit. Every trace walks create-notification, origin and commodity search (other parts' pages) as set-up before reaching the slice; only the reason page and the redirect onward are claimed here. Page inventory: one page, /design-release-2.1/reason-for-import 'Main import reason' (always appears, after What are you importing?), in two variants: live animals (five reasons, four with conditional reveals) and germinal products (two reasons). Conditional surface: Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market' radios (11 purposes for live animals, 4 for germinal); Transhipment or onward travel reveals a Destination country select; Transit reveals Port of exit and Destination country selects; Temporary admission horses reveals an Exit date (MOJ date picker) and a Port of exit select; Re-entry reveals nothing. Error states driven: purpose missing, transhipment destination missing, transit port and destination missing, temporary admission date and port missing, an unreal date (31/2/2026), and a real date with the port missing. The next page is /consignment-details 'Commodity details' (part 4 owns it). Also mined: the seed route /prototype/reason-for-import (302 to /reason-for-import), no-JavaScript snapshots from S10, S11 and S12, the date picker dialog open (S11), and the network log of every trace (form posts only; no data calls from the reason page). Snapshot pointers: trace 1 action 34 (page at rest), trace 3 action 44, trace 4 action 44, trace 5 action 43, trace 6 actions 44 and 57, trace 8 actions 40, 54 and 67, S10 actions 43, 49 and 70, S11 actions 44 and 53, S12 actions 39, 46 and 56.
